key.name: show-level-numbers
key.summary: Show numeric input level beside the panel icon
key.description: The icon fills with the live input level regardless of this setting. Numbers remain visible in the menu and native app.

key.name: meter-enabled
key.description: Subscribe to shared audio metering while the extension is enabled. The daemon processes audio in memory without recording it.

key.name: daemon-url
key.description: Loopback HTTP or HTTPS address of the existing Go daemon.
